Io, the Herbal Witch

Her body and base outfit, built from your round 1 paintings B2, B3, B4 and B5. Drag to turn her, pinch or scroll to zoom. Her head is a plain form for now: her face, hair, glasses and hat are the next stage, and the robe comes after that.

What is here

  • Body proportions measured off the paintings. Waist, hips, bust, shoulders, arms and the skirt's outline are within about a centimetre of B3 from the front and B2 from the side.
  • Bodice: your paintings wrapped right round her (B3 front and back, B2 at the sides).
  • Skirt: eight tiers with the slit over her left leg, cut to the outline in B3 and B2. Its lace is a piece of B4.
  • Bare arms and legs in her skin colour. Her knee, hip and boot heights come from B5.

What is a stand-in, and what is not here yet

  • The skirt is stiff and its lace is solid. It becomes hanging, see-through cloth later, and wants the lace square from round 2.
  • The boots are the Jester's boot made taller. Her own (the strap and buckle, gold stitching) come in the boots stage, from E1 to E8.
  • Arms, legs and hands are plain skin, with no painted detail yet.
  • Not here yet: face, hair, glasses, hat, robe, belt, pouch, crystal, necklaces, bracelets, book, blades, and all movement.
